segments.an4.96:2.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya?
segments.an4.96:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo attanā rāgavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, no paraṃ rāgavinayāya samādapeti;
segments.an4.96:2.3: attanā dosavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, no paraṃ dosavinayāya samādapeti;
segments.an4.96:2.4: attanā mohavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, no paraṃ mohavinayāya samādapeti.
segments.an4.96:2.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no parahitāya.
segments.an4.96:3.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no attahitāya?
segments.an4.96:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo attanā na rāgavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, paraṃ rāgavinayāya samādapeti;
segments.an4.96:3.3: attanā na dosavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, paraṃ dosavinayāya samādapeti;
segments.an4.96:3.4: attanā na mohavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, paraṃ mohavinayāya samādapeti.
segments.an4.96:3.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no attahitāya.
segments.an4.96:4.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo nevattahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no parahitāya?
segments.an4.96:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo attanā na rāgavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, no paraṃ rāgavinayāya samādapeti;
segments.an4.96:4.3: attanā na dosavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, no paraṃ dosavinayāya samādapeti;
segments.an4.96:4.4: attanā na mohavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, no paraṃ mohavinayāya samādapeti.
segments.an4.96:4.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo nevattahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no parahitāya.
segments.an4.96:5.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya ceva paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca?
segments.an4.96:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo attanā ca rāgavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, parañca rāgavinayāya samādapeti;
segments.an4.96:5.3: attanā ca dosavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, parañca dosavinayāya samādapeti;
segments.an4.96:5.4: attanā ca mohavinayāya paṭipanno hoti, parañca mohavinayāya samādapeti.
segments.an4.96:5.5: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya ceva paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca.
segments.an4.96:5.6: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmi”nti.

lines: Majjhaṭṭhāne gūthamakkhitanti pamāṇena aṭṭhaṅgulamattaṃ dvīsu ṭhānesu ādittaṃ majjhe gūthamakkhitaṃ.
